Full-time | On-site | Admiralty, Hong Kong

About TITUS

TITUS is a modern, independent Hong Kong law firm based in Lippo Centre, Admiralty, acting for clients ranging from individuals to multinational corporations.

Our Family Law team advises on divorce and separation, financial arrangements, children matters and pre- and post-nuptial agreements, often for high-net-worth clients and frequently involving cross-border issues.

The opportunity

We are looking for a motivated Paralegal to support our Family Law team on matrimonial and family matters, with occasional assistance to other teams as workload requires.

You will work closely with experienced solicitors and develop your drafting, document management and case-management skills.

Key responsibilities

Working under the supervision of solicitors, your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting solicitors on matrimonial and family proceedings, including divorce, financial and ancillary relief applications, children matters and, where applicable, cross-border issues.

• Preparing first drafts of affidavits, court documents and correspondence, and collating disclosure and hearing bundles.

• Attending court hearings, counsel conferences and mediations, and taking attendance notes.

• Assisting with pre- and post-nuptial agreements and settlement documentation.

• Assisting with client communications and liaising with counsel, experts, court registries and other professionals.

• Conducting legal research for solicitors’ review.

• Managing files, diarising deadlines, and filing and serving documents.

• Assisting with occasional civil litigation matters and general administration, including billing and time recording.

What we are looking for

• A law degree, PCLL or recognised paralegal qualification, with 1–3 years’ paralegal experience in family law or litigation (recent graduates with relevant internship experience considered).

• Working knowledge of Hong Kong family and civil court procedure; cross-border experience an advantage.

• Strong research and drafting skills and close attention to detail.

• Excellent written and spoken English; Chinese preferred, but not essential.

• Discretion and empathy in handling sensitive personal and financial matters.

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines, working both independently and as part of a team.

• A genuine interest in family law.

How to apply

Please apply through LinkedIn, or send your CV and a brief covering letter to hr@titus.com.hk, indicating your relevant experience, availability and salary expectations.

TITUS welcomes applications from suitable candidates from all backgrounds. Applications will be assessed on relevant qualifications, experience and suitability for the role.

Personal information provided will be used for recruitment purposes only.

Applications remain open until the position is filled.
